inputCopy.value: The text value to display and copy to clipboard.
inputCopy.label: Optional label displayed above the input.
inputCopy.variant: Icon-only with tooltip, or button with visible label.
inputCopy.align: Position of the copy action relative to the value.
inputCopy.onCopy: Callback fired after the value is successfully copied.
inputCopy.disabledProp: Disables the input and copy button.
